explanation: The battle's own article places it before the war and inside its causation in one sentence: "This battle is an antecedent of the Arauco War." It is the first fighting between Spanish conquistadors and the Mapuche, ten years before the war this atlas dates from 1546. That is why this atlas does not file it under the war as Wikidata's P361 does, and carries this edge instead. Precondition-of: an antecedent is what the article claims. A battle at the confluence of the Ñuble and the Itata does not bring about a war that starts a decade later. It is what the war was already under way from.
